location_description:
North El Monte (pronunciation) is a census-designated place (CDP) in the San Gabriel Valley, in Los Angeles County, California, United States. The population was 3,723 at the 2010 census, up from 3,703 at the 2000 census.


== Geography ==
According to the United States Census Bureau, the CDP has a total area of 0.4 square miles (1.0 km2), all land.
